data.title: A pillar of environmental enforcement is targeted by Trump and Musk's AI company
data.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Right-leaning legal activists along with Elon Musk ’s artificial intelligence company have brought sweeping challenges against a cornerstone of legal enforcement in the United States: the right of private groups, people and local governments to sue over violations of many major ...
